changelog:
Precision
 Lyrics Focus: tap cover to toggle full-screen lyrics, centered current line, scroll to browse, double-tap to seek. Portrait/landscape remembers expansion. Tighter after track changes, no jump on pause. Path: Settings → Interaction → Media & Playback → Detailed metadata.

Karaoke lyrics (Beta): active line lights left-to-right with vocal. Stricter QQ Music + LRCLIB matching, fewer wrong songs, no forced lyrics on incomplete artist. Path: Settings → Interaction → Media & Playback → Karaoke lyrics.

Sendspin sync: reduced drift during long multi-room playback. Music overlay FAB: fixed reappear after auto-hide.

WebView Health Steward: improved sluggish dashboards #161. Entity filtering off by default, custom card type paste support. Hidden browser pauses animations, media, HA push updates. Memory and frame-rate options added. Path: Settings → Browser → WebView Health Steward.

microWakeWord speech gating: lightweight gate reduces false wakes from TV hum, bumps. Threshold display more consistent in Voice Stats. Path: Settings → Voice → Wake word.

Hear It Yourself: record and compare noise suppression/echo cancellation before/after on device. Echo cancellation smoother, less choppy. Path: Settings → Voice → Microphone.

Single-lens camera: rear-only devices no longer black forever. Thanks @gilcu2 #163. Path: Settings → Experimental → Device camera.

In-app updates adjusted for kiosk devices #164. Thanks @lone-baggie. Website Console: immediate on first enable. Simple clock portrait weather icon fixed. Floating browser back label aligned. Localization: mixed translations and long strings fixed.
